title: Binary word determined by its value
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean word and $n\in\mathbb{N}$. If $n<2^{|w|}$ and interpreting the entries of $w$ as binary digits, least significant digit first, gives the value $n$, then $w$ is the length-$|w|$ list of binary digits of $n$, with each position recording the corresponding binary place value.
hypotheses_covered: The binary value of $w$, read least significant digit first, is $n$
